column1: # repo-kinds.tsv (harbor#950) — the top-level entries each kind of repo carries (standards/naming.md §8).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every repo, harbor included (D-37), mirrors one filesystem schema, so a
# reader who knows one repo can find their way in any other. The schema lives here so the
# scaffolder (`yard`) can create repos from it, a lint can check it, and the fleet controller
# (`fleet`) can report what drifted. Checked by `bin/lint-name.sh --check repo-kind <dir>` and by
# nothing else, never by a tree scan: harbor's own layout moves in harbor#956, and a scan would
# report the migration plan as findings. The kind a directory is judged as is the `repo-kind:` line
# of its .agents/config.yaml; the check reads `required` (a missing or wrong-sort entry is
# name.repo-kind) and ignores `optional` and any entry the kind does not list.
#   required, optional   space-separated entries; a trailing / marks a directory
#   machine-read kinds (policy/ standards/ contracts/ registries/) are present only when non-empty
